cases.note: NFC composes a precomposed syllable and a trailing jamo: the edit's Z, U+AC00, U+11A8 token is the instruction's Z, U+AC01 after NFC, so it appears and nothing is flagged.

cases.note: NFC before matching: a decomposed o-tilde equals the instruction's precomposed one; text stays as sent.

cases.note: An empty text deletes the line: length 0, inRange true and isDeletion true.
A text that is empty after jsTrim is a deletion too; the text stays as sent.
A text of punctuation alone is not empty, so it is no deletion; its length is 0.
Items missing a field or with a wrong type are dropped and counted (ai.md §2.3).

cases.note: Keys outside the schema are ignored.
The line id is compared after jsTrim.
A reply in a json code fence is extracted (ai.md §4.5).
A fence with no line break is all opening fence line, so nothing is left to parse (ai.md §4.5).
Text around the object: the whole text fails to parse, so the first balanced object is used.

cases.note: The balanced-object scan reads Unicode scalars: a combining mark after a quote does not hide the quote, so the brace inside the reason stays inside its string.

cases.note: jsTrim removes a leading U+FEFF before parsing.
The whole text parses, but as an array, so there is no object (ai.md §2.3).
A repeated key keeps its first value, for both services.
Inside an edit too: the first "line" is unknown, so the edit is dropped as unknown.
Repeated keys outside the schema change nothing.
The unused second value of a repeated key must still be valid: it holds an unpaired surrogate escape.
An escaped unpaired surrogate in any string makes the reply invalid.
The same in a reason.
The same in a key outside the schema.
The same in a key name.
A low surrogate escape before a high one is two unpaired surrogates.
A high and low surrogate escape in order is one emoji, which does not count.
The top-level object and 63 arrays inside an ignored key: 64 levels are allowed.
One level more and the reply is invalid.
A number beyond the double range makes the reply invalid, even in an ignored key.
The same below the double range.
A 310-digit integer does not fit a double either.
A non-zero number that rounds to zero does not fit.
A small number that a double still holds is fine.
Zero is zero whatever its exponent.
An exact zero with an exponent is a valid number.
The same with a capital E.
A zero fraction with a negative exponent is zero too.
So is a negative zero with an exponent.
NaN is not JSON.
An escaped U+FFFE in the new text and the rewrite is kept as sent and counts nothing.
The same with U+FFFE written as itself.
U+FFFE in the instruction: its 2025 still appears, so nothing is flagged.

cases.note: The rewrite rules reject every Cc but a line break: here DEL and NEL. The edits are fine.
A rewrite that is empty after jsTrim is invalid; U+FEFF is JavaScript whitespace.
A refusal is the refused error on both services, whatever the text.
An incomplete reply is the truncated error.
An empty edits list is a valid result.
A reply with no JSON object is a typed error.
